source: real Codex (stock npm build) in an isolated herdr-core 0.1.17 session, 2026-11-03
scrubbed: account ids, credits/plan, encrypted reasoning, base/developer instructions, tool schemas; paths rewritten to /home/user/...

scenarios.name: simple-reply
scenarios.shows: One turn, plain text reply ('pong'). t1 status working -> done.

scenarios.name: permission-exec
scenarios.shows: Read-only sandbox: exec fails, retried with sandbox_permissions=require_escalated; terminal blocked kind=permission; answered with key 'y'; CommandExecution item; empty final answer.

scenarios.name: rotation-new-diff-image
scenarios.shows: Second thread in the same process after '/new' (rotation). apply_patch FileChange needing approval (blocked kind=permission, answered with 'enter'), then view_image ImageView, final answer 'Red'.

scenarios.name: question-then-resume
scenarios.shows: request_user_input question (blocked kind=question, answered 'down enter' = Blue), then the process quit and `codex resume <id>` appended a second turn to the SAME rollout file.

scenarios.name: thinking-user-image
scenarios.shows: Reasoning item with summary_text (encrypted_content redacted), user-attached image via -i (input_image data URL + local_image), plus -i read errors for comma-split bogus paths.

scenarios.name: error-model
scenarios.shows: Turn fails before any model output: task_complete.error {message, codex_error_info=model_not_found}; terminal status error.

scenarios.name: daemon-mode
scenarios.shows: Codex typed into a plain shell terminal WITHOUT --no-daemon; rollout written by the app-server daemon.
